answer: Dentascan images the mandible in axial, panoramic and cross-sectional planes, clearly showing cortical bone margins and the inferior alveolar canal. It enables bone measurements and assessment of volume and density, simulation of implant placement or bone grafting, and localization of teeth and the mandibular canal to guide surgery.
